# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- No recorded fixture, so no checked example: a replay needs a stub bridge that also fakes the written files. The envelope keys above are read from the object PrideDownloadAsync returns, not from a recording.
- The unmatched-selection check runs after the download, so a typo in one name still downloads every other selected file before failing. Checking the manifest first would need the bridge to fetch it separately from DownloadProjectFilesAsync.
- A zero-match filter is a usage error in the bindings but a success on the wire; whether the wire should raise it (as it does for an unmatched names-from-stdin selection) is undecided.
